subject: general
question: Which of the following options is correct when data is classified on the basis of attributes?
solution:
The correct answer is **Qualitative classification.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Qualitative classification** is a method of grouping data based on attributes or qualities that are inherent in the data.
 
• The data is classified into categories based on its characteristics, such as color, shape, size, or texture.
 
• **Qualitative classification** groups data based on attributes or qualities inherent in the data.
 
• The data is classified into categories based on its characteristics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Qualitative classification is often used in fields such as biology, sociology, and psychology to categorize individuals or objects based on specific traits.
 
• Qualitative classification should be used when the data being classified cannot be easily quantified.
 
• The categories used in qualitative classification should be mutually exclusive and exhaustive, meaning that each item should only belong to one category and all items should belong to at least one category.
 
• The number of categories used in qualitative classification should be kept to a minimum to ensure the accuracy and usefulness of the classification.
